Never turn a prior held204 release-ready flag into approval.

Suggested terminal JSON fields: record_id, outcome, proposed_title, proposed_description_short, proposed_description_medium, proposed_description_long, focused_rescue, sources_consulted (URL plus supported facts/limitations), remaining_gap, exclusion_reason, provenance. frozen_original.synopsis: In early 2021, the National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) realized significant presidential records were missing from their transfers. Throughout 2021 and into 2022, they repeatedly contacted Trump's representatives demanding the return of the documents taken to Mar-a-Lago.
frozen_original.title: National Archives Discovers Missing Documents

proposal.description_medium: NARA said it worked with Trump representatives in 2021 to locate presidential records not transferred when his administration ended. The agency reported that a representative said some records were found in December; NARA arranged secure transport and received 15 boxes from Mar-a-Lago in January 2022. Representatives were still searching for additional records. This official account supports a records search and transfer, not an unspecified discovery of a particular set of missing documents. The originally linked January 6 release does not document this timeline.
